From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>

Subject: Catalyst GSI collaboration — quick recap + proposed next step

Hi Priya / Daniel —

Great to meet you both on the call earlier. Quick recap while everything's fresh and a few proposed next steps so we can lock a technical deep dive: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: get Redwood inference integrated as a Managed Marketplace listing for Catalyst customers and validate the runtime/network flow for private deployments.
- Top success criteria: predictable latency <150ms p99 for short-form generation; clear onboarding docs for deploy-to-VPC; simplified billing mapping for Marketplace SKU.

Open items we agreed to investigate
1) Marketplace listing requirements (billing/entitlement flow) — Daniel to confirm Catalyst marketplace onboarding checklist.
2) Network/topology constraints for private deployments — Priya to share any existing topology diagrams or strict firewall rules.
3) SE session to walk through model serving architecture & demo the Redwood Console capabilities.

Proposed next step
- Schedule a 60-minute technical deep dive (SE + Partner Ops + Catalyst product) to cover: architecture, listing flow, sample payloads, and a short demo of the Console.
- Proposed windows (all PT): Mon 24 May 09:00–11:00, Wed 26 May 10:00–12:00, Thu 27 May 14:00–16:00. If none work, share two times that do.

Attachments: Catalyst_Redwood_MA_plan.pdf (high-level mutual action plan).

Can you confirm which window works and whether you want a heavier focus on marketplace entitlements vs. deployment networking? I’ll loop in our Partner Ops for the logistics once we have a time.

Thanks —
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0193
Redwood Inference

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the clear summary — this aligns with our notes. We’re very interested in progressing to the technical deep dive. My team prefers Wed 26 May 10:00–11:30 PT if that works for your SE. I’ve attached a short topology doc we referenced on the call.

Short answers to your open items:
- Marketplace checklist: Daniel is pulling the latest onboarding doc and will confirm whether Catalyst requires a sandbox listing prior to production.
- Network constraints: we typically have an allowlist approach and require ingress TLS with mutual auth for our private deployments. See attached.

Agenda request: please reserve ~25 minutes for the deployment/networking deep-dive and ~20 minutes for the Console demo; the remaining time for Q&A & next steps.

Attachments: Catalyst_prod_topology.pdf

Best,
